title: SREV-069 SXS ActCtx temp buffer gate contract

actctx_input.description: ACTCTXW lpSource and lpAssemblyDirectory path inputs

fallback.description: Underlying CreateActCtxW call when local path translation is skipped

contracts: CreateActCtxW receives an ACTCTXW pointer that contains activation context information
ACTCTXW lpSource is a null-terminated path string
wmemcpy requires valid source and destination buffers for the requested character count
args.Directory may be copied into only after Dll_AllocTemp returns a non-null buffer
MySource may be passed to SbieDll_GetHandlePath only after Dll_AllocTemp returns a non-null buffer
TruePath2 may receive a trailing-slash copy only after Dll_AllocTemp returns a non-null buffer
If local alternate path translation cannot allocate its temp buffer, the wrapper must fall through to the underlying CreateActCtxW owner
